commands.label: 06-sdk-imports-inventory
args:
import importlib.metadata as m
import json,re,site,sys
from pathlib import Path
import duckdb,pandas,alpaca,exchange_calendars,openai,openai_codex,numpy
from openai_codex import AsyncCodex, ApprovalMode, CodexConfig, Sandbox
from openai_codex.client import CodexClient
from openai_codex.generated.v2_all import GetAccountRateLimitsResponse
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',s).lower()
lock=Path('adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock').read_text()
expected={norm(n):v for n,v in re.findall(r'^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)==([^\\\s]+)',lock,re.M)}
installed={norm(d.metadata['Name']):d.version for d in m.distributions()}
modules={name: {'version':m.version(dist),'file':str(Path(mod.__file__).resolve()),'inside_prefix':Path(mod.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve())} for name,dist,mod in [('duckdb','duckdb',duckdb),('pandas','pandas',pandas),('alpaca','alpaca-py',alpaca),('exchange_calendars','exchange-calendars',exchange_calendars),('openai','openai',openai),('openai_codex','openai-codex',openai_codex),('numpy','numpy',numpy)]}
result=dict(python=sys.version,prefix=sys.prefix,base_prefix=sys.base_prefix,system_site_packages='include-system-site-packages = true' in (Path(sys.prefix)/'pyvenv.cfg').read_text(),user_site_enabled=site.ENABLE_USER_SITE,lock_count=len(expected),installed_count=len(installed),exact_name_version_match=installed==expected,missing=sorted(set(expected)-set(installed)),extra=sorted(set(installed)-set(expected)),version_mismatches={k:[v,installed.get(k)] for k,v in expected.items() if installed.get(k)!=v},imports=modules,sdk_worker_symbols_imported=['AsyncCodex','ApprovalMode','CodexConfig','Sandbox','CodexClient','GetAccountRateLimitsResponse'],duckdb_fixture=duckdb.sql('select sum(x) from (values (1),(2),(3)) t(x)').fetchone()[0])
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert installed==expected
assert all(v['inside_prefix'] for v in modules.values())
assert result['duckdb_fixture']==6
assert not result['system_site_packages'] and not result['user_site_enabled']
